title: the watch rebuilds the report reader every frame, so its cache never holds
body:
report.go's cache doc promises 'a two-second redraw must not spawn git every frame', but localStatusModel constructs a fresh AttemptReports closure (and therefore a fresh empty cache) on every model build, and the watch builds the model every frame — so the drill-in re-runs rev-parse/merge-base/log per settled tick per redraw. Pre-existing (the closure was already per-frame before the run-key change); out of this tick's scope, but the doc's claim and the wiring disagree.
evidence: internal/cli/status_model.go:529 (AttemptReports built inside localStatusModel); internal/cli/watch.go:713,827 (localStatusModel per frame); internal/statusmodel/report.go attemptReports cache
